title: 50-A capture event
description: Generic Sheet row contract. The milestone-one endpoint accepts only water/add/1/gallon/alexa with blank merchant and category and synced=false. Future modules require explicit handler validation changes.

event_id.description: Immutable globally unique event identifier; Alexa uses alexa: plus its requestId.

timestamp.description: Event occurrence in canonical UTC ISO 8601, stored as text.

synced.description: False until a future importer durably applies the event. Not a multi-device acknowledgement protocol.
